author: IviFetita
body:
Raw Islands [DTM]  


It is a DTM map ( I know, it is small) with 2 spawns and 2 monuments. This map has islands, be cause that, it's named Raw Islands. 
there are 2 teams:
  • Red Team (1 monument)
  • Blue team (1 monument)

The map spotlight from the sky:

The monuments are in front of the spawns, and the diamonds were removed from the islands. Two small towers to shot the enemy team when is attaching your team monument.

Here is the screenshots album: 
Download:  https://www.mediafire.com/?22m3ap433w094km

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Very limited gameplay, very limited space, and... diamonds...?
The spawn structures aren't good, and they'll be as bad or worse than in Checkmate. I don't simply see this map having a good gameplay at all. I don't really know what to recommend, if not an overall improvement of the map

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
It's very small, there is no room for building or melee, as most deaths will probably occur with a bow.
Make it larger, and add structures and more land which will contribute to a better gameplay of the map.
Good luck.
